description:

Gluten-Free

A gluten-free diet excludes the protein gluten. Gluten is found in grains such as wheat, barley, rye, and a cross between wheat and rye called triticale.

WIldlflour operates in a dedicated gluten-free facility and offers a wide variety of baked goods including French baguettes, tea loaves, cookies, custom cakes and more. Wildflour also offers premix packs for bake at home goodness. Gluten Out – Taste and Texture In. A gluten-free diet is essential for managing signs and symptoms of celiac disease and other medical conditions associated with gluten. A gluten-free diet is, however, popular among people without gluten-related medical conditions. Wildflour Gluten-Free Baking Co. offers a wide variety of Gluten-Free baked goods - the best in taste and texture. Locally owned, family business with one of the only dedicated gluten free facilities in the Pacific Northwest!

Our Story

The Wildflour Gluten Free Baking Co. story starts in 1993 when the founder was dealing with severe GI issues. In those days, gluten intolerance was not a common diagnosis, but her doctorate program studies included nutrition and gastroenterology.

She found by eliminating wheat from her diet, her symptoms were resolved. So began a 25-year adventure into replacing gluten with alternatives which are both tasty and replicate the texture so lacking in many of the then available gluten-free options.

In 2010 she opened the bakery and fast forward to 2019, enter Jay Gordon. What he found was a true gem and on August 1, 2019 Jay purchased and began operating Wildflour Gluten Free Baking Co. While things are always changing and evolving, the proprietary flour blends and recipes have and will always remain the same.

description:
Perfect for your family's weekend breakfast with Multi-Color Pancakes. This Multi-Color Pancake Mix will turn your ordinary morning meal into a true feast of taste and color. Great taste and fun colors make these best-ever breakfast cakes a hit with both kids and adults alike.
Cooking Multi-Color Pancakes is easy and fun. Simply use the recipe below and follow step-by-step instructions.

To make Multi-Color Pancakes you will need the following ingredients:

  • 1 package of pancake mix
  • 0.18 pound - 85 grams of melted butter
  • 0.5 Cup\ 3.7 fl oz\ 110 milliliters of milk
  • 3 large eggs

    • Cooking instructions:

    1. Melt butter in a microwave for 30 seconds, set aside.

    2. In a small bowl whisk milk and eggs together.

    3. Add pancake mix into a large bowl.

    4. Pour melted butter and milk and eggs mixture into the bowl with the pancake mix.

    5. Using a whisk, mix all the ingredients into a batter just enough to bring it together. No need to mix the batter until all lumps are gone because they will dissolve naturally. The batter should be thick yet able to run slowly and nicely off of the spoon.

    6. Allow the batter to rest for a few minutes while heating a lightly oiled frying pan or a griddle to medium high heat.

    7. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake onto the griddle

    8. Cook each side for 3-6 minutes, until lightly golden-brown outside.

    9. .Enjoy

    This recipe makes approximately 8 to 10 pancakes (400g).

    Can this pancake recipe be used to make waffles?
    Yes!

    Can this pancake recipe be made into mini pancakes or "silver dollar"pancakes?
    Yes!

    Can these pancakes be frozen?

Perfect for your family's weekend breakfast with Multi-Color Pancakes. This Multi-Color Pancake Mix will turn your ordinary morning meal into a true feast of taste and color. Great taste and fun colors make these best-ever breakfast cakes a hit with both kids and adults alike.
Cooking Multi-Color Pancakes is easy and fun. Simply use the recipe below and follow step-by-step instructions.

To make Multi-Color Pancakes you will need the following ingredients:

  • 1 package of pancake mix
  • 0.18 pound - 85 grams of melted butter
  • 0.5 Cup\ 3.7 fl oz\ 110 milliliters of milk
  • 3 large eggs

    • Cooking instructions:

    1. Melt butter in a microwave for 30 seconds, set aside.

    2. In a small bowl whisk milk and eggs together.

    3. Add pancake mix into a large bowl.

    4. Pour melted butter and milk and eggs mixture into the bowl with the pancake mix.

    5. Using a whisk, mix all the ingredients into a batter just enough to bring it together. No need to mix the batter until all lumps are gone because they will dissolve naturally. The batter should be thick yet able to run slowly and nicely off of the spoon.

    6. Allow the batter to rest for a few minutes while heating a lightly oiled frying pan or a griddle to medium high heat.

    7. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake onto the griddle

    8. Cook each side for 3-6 minutes, until lightly golden-brown outside.

    9. .Enjoy

    This recipe makes approximately 8 to 10 pancakes (400g).

    Can this pancake recipe be made into mini pancakes or "silver dollar"pancakes?
    Yes!

description:
Remember when a sandwich was a staple in your diet? Maybe you preferred a toasty warm grilled panini? It’s possible again with our rustic gluten free mix. This is not a soft squishy bread from your childhood, but a firm one like a whole grain loaf without any grains, nuts or seeds. With a subtle nutty undertone and a light sourdough-like aroma, it will make your kitchen smell like your local bakery. Bake a loaf up, slice when cool, enjoy a few pieces and squirrel some away in your freezer for those times you just need a simple and satisfying piece of toast.

Our mix also makes aip pizza crust! For two 12” crusts, no kombucha is needed. Mix one package of Rustic Bread Mix, 2 tablespoons of oil and 1 ½ cups cold water until you have a soft dough. Using wet hands or a silicone spatula, press dough into two 12” circles. Bake at 450 degrees for 15-17 minutes. Add your toppings and return to the oven for 5-8 minutes.

Enjoy this tasty aip vegan bread in your paleo diet as a wholesome, nutritious snack. This paleo gluten free bread can be a welcome addition to your gluten free, dairy free, soy free, egg free snacks while on an aip diet. Get ready to impress with this tasty loaf for dinner parties, picnics, and cookouts!

Tips for baking the perfect loaf: Let’s be real. AIP baking can be challenging. The main thing to remember is DO NOT UNDERBAKE your loaf of bread. It will brown well and may deceive you into thinking 50-60 minutes is too long, but do not be tricked into removing it from your oven too soon! A 5x5 loaf pan also works but may need to cook longer than the recommended time. Make sure it is completely cool before slicing to your preferred thickness.

Troubleshooting: If you accidentally undercook your bread, do not despair. If it feels more than a touch sticky after slicing, place your slices on a baking sheet in a 350 degree oven for 2-3 minutes, or until dry to the touch, then flip and repeat for the other side.

description: It gets cold in New England. So it's not surprising that New Englanders make bread with substance. This wholesome bread is made with eight hearty grains a great heritage bread that your family will enjoy, a wholesome bread without preservatives. Grains can be used in bread in four forms: As flours--though only wheat flour has the proteins to form gluten, which gives bread it's chewy, elastic texture. As rolled grains. Rolled oats and other rolled grains meld into the bread but make the bread chewy and moist. As finely chopped grains. Finely chopped grains may be the consistency of coarse salt but cook soft and nearly unnoticeable. They give the bread a chewy, hearty texture with occasional grains. As coarsely chopped grains. Coarsely chopped grains are distinct, chewy nuggets in the bread. Often, they are presoaked to make them softer. In a bread machine, with a three-hour cycle, the grains are softened. The grains in this bread are finely chopped. They bake soft and chewy, with a hardy and wholesome texture yet the bread is still soft and moist. The bread is nearly white so the kids will accept it as one of their favorites. A great bread for toast and sandwiches. A soft, moist bread that your family will love. Don't miss this great bread. If you make this bread in your bread machine, water temperature is critical. Please use a thermometer to measure water at exactly 80 degrees. A ten-degree difference in water temperature can double the growth rate of the yeast.

Bake In A Minute Simple Recipes

Original Mug Bread

25g (¼ cup) Bake In A Minute mix

1 whole egg (white of the egg works as well)

1 tbsp. butter/oil.

Mix all ingredients above, in a microwave safe mug or small bowl.

Microwave on high for 90 seconds. (microwave times may vary)



Easy Mini-Bread Loaf

(Preheat oven to 350F.)

100g (1 cup) of Bake In A Minute

2 - 3 eggs (preference)

4 tbsp butter/oil

Mix all ingredients above in a bowl.

Place in a parchment lined or buttered loaf pan. A mini-loaf pan will also work well.

Bake at 350F for approx. 25 min. or until a toothpick comes out clean.

Bread loaf may come out flatter in a regular size loaf pan. A full size loaf is 200g of mix.



Pizza Crust (Preheat oven to 350F.)

100g (1 cup) Bake In A Minute mix

2 eggs

4 tbsp butter/oil

Mix all ingredients above, in a bowl.

Spread dough on parchment lined cookie sheet and flatten with a rolling pin.

Bake for 8-10 min.

Spread sauce, cheese and add your favorite toppings.

Bake for another 5 minutes or until toppings are heated through and cheese has melted.

Bake for additional 3-5 min. for a crispier crust.

description:
Did you know half of moms stop breastfeeding within the first six months because of milk supply issues?

Milkmakers cookies are a delicious, convenient way for nursing moms to get extra nourishment to help support lactation.

Milkmakers Lactation Cookie Mix in Oatmeal Chocolate Chip is chock-full of semi-sweet chocolate chunks and chewy oatmeal. A mix makes 12 cookies. Bake them up with butter or dairy-free. Milkmakers cookies are organic, natural, preservative-free and fenugreek-free.

How do lactation cookies work?

Oats help support breast milk supply, and are a nutritional powerhouse, providing whole grains, fiber, iron, and an abundance of healthy vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Brewer’s yeast is a traditional remedy used to stimulate the production of breast milk and is a rich source of the B-vitamins and amino acids essential for nursing moms and their babies. Flaxseed provides omega-3 fatty acids, necessary for brain development, which can be passed through breast milk. These ingredients work together to make Milkmakers a wholesome snack for breastfeeding moms.

For Best Results

One or two lactation cookies every day can help support a healthy milk supply. While every woman's body is different, most moms notice more milk production after a few days.

Grab and Go

Too busy to eat? Tuck a cookie in your bag and you're ready for another busy breast feeding day. Hospitals and lactation consultants love our breastfeeding cookies too!

Our Story

Emily Kane, founder of Milkmakers, created Milkmakers cookies because she needed them. After her baby was born, she went back to work. Her milk supply went down and a lactation consultant recommended lactation cookies. She saw an immediate boost. Milkmakers Cookies and Milkmakers Tea are designed to make breastfeeding less stressful so that moms can focus on what really matters.

Go Moms!

description:
PERFECTLY BALANCED, ALL-NATURAL, EASY TO MAKE KETO PANCAKE MIX

We bet you never thought pancakes or waffles would be on the menu while on a ketogenic diet! This all-natural Keto Pancake Mix breaks the mold with it's super delicious and keto-friendly recipe with only 1g of net carbs per 2 pancake serving

  • 4 incredible flavours, naturally sweetened with stevia
  • 3g of healthy MCTs per serving from coconut oil
  • Zero added sugar (<1g sugar naturally occurring from egg)
  • All-natural formula, gluten-free, keto, paleo & vegetarian friendly

 

HOW TO MAKE

  1. Whisk 1 cup of KETO Pancake Mix into 3oz (90ml) cold water
  2. Let stand 3-4 minutes to thicken
  3. Pour batter into 3-4 inch pancakes on a preheated skillet or griddle
  4. Flip when bubbles stop forming and bottom is golden brown
  5. Cook for 1 more minute or until second side is golden brown
  6. Makes about 3 servings (6 pancakes)

 

FOR WAFFLES

  1. Prepare the batter as per directions above but use slightly less water to achieve a thicker batter consistency
  2. Cook according to your waffle iron instructions

 

WANT MORE PROTEIN?

Add a scoop of ANS Protein Powder or mix an egg into the batter.

description: Paradise Fruit Company was incorporated in 1961 as part of Canaveral Utilities and Development Co., a land development operation on the east coast of Florida. The name "Paradise", a label used by a company that had been in the 'glace' (candied) fruit business since the end of WW2, was acquired by Canaveral during the year of incorporation. After several acquisitions and mergers with similar businesses, 'glace' fruit became the major segment of the company's business. In 1965, the name was changed to Paradise Fruit Company, Inc. During those years, there were a number of relatively small operations manufacturing candied fruit, primarily for sale to commercial bakers. The management of Paradise anticipated that there was a great potential for direct sales to homemakers through supermarkets. Over a period of several years, Paradise developed the now familiar transparent, reusable plastic containers found in almost every supermarket during the holiday season. In order to become more immediately responsive to its customers needs, the company invested in a facility to manufacture all of its packaging. This, combined with large inventories, enabled almost overnight filling and shipping of orders. During the same period, the company acquired, merged with, or was licensed by a number of competitors to become the leading marketer of 'glace' fruit products under labels that have been trusted and asked for by customers for generations. Given the increasing diversification, the name of the company was changed to Paradise, Inc. in 1993. Paradise remains an innovator in 'glace' fruit marketing, introducing in 2003 a new package design that incorporates recipes and a cash-redeemable coupon.

description: INSTRUCTIONS FOR MERINGUE POWDER: ROYAL ICING. (DRY HARD ICING). Into ½ cup cold water, beat ¼ cup meringue powder until peaks form. Dissolve ¾ cup of granular sugar in ½ cup boiling water. Cool and add ¼ cup meringue powder and beat to peak. Stir in 1 pound sifted confectioner’s sugar and beat until mixed well: mix in 2 to 2-1/2 cups white vegetable shortening. BOILED ICING. Dissolve and boil at high heat (240°F). 2 cups granular sugar in ¾ cup water, ¼ cup corn syrup and small pinch of salt. Dissolve and whip 3/8 cup (6 tablespoons) meringue powder in 1 cup cold water: add 1 cup granular sugar while beating meringue mix: slowly add boiled syrup. Then whip at high speed until cool. MERINGUE TOPPING. (FOR MERINGUE SHELLS, PIE TOPPINGS). Dissolve ¾ cup granular sugar in ½ cup boiling water, cool. Add ¼ cup meringue powder and beat to high peak. HINTS: Keep utensils grease free. Icing may be refrigerated in airtight containers, beat again before using. description:
Stride into your day #FEARLESS with our #Fearless Pancake & Waffle Mix. If you’ve been craving a real breakfast since starting a Keto diet, here is your answer!

  • 👑Made with Omega-3 Rich California Walnut Flour
  • 💪3g Net Carbs, 8g Protein, 24g Fat, & 5g Fiber per Serving
  • 😋Sweetened with Monk Fruit, Stevia, & Erythritol
  • 🍌No Added Sugars or Artificial Flavors
  • ⏰Fast & Easy to Make
  • 🍩Incredibly Versatile. Make a Variety of Baked Goods!
  • 💌Family Owned & Crafted with Love

It’s impossible to think of breakfast without thinking of pancakes & waffles *cue the drooling* 🤤. With our Fearless Pancake & Waffle mix, you can finally turn a once unhealthy sugar-filled breakfast treat into a healthy, low carb, and delicious way to consistently start your day! Each serving contains 1 ounce of walnuts, making these pancakes and waffles an amazing source of antioxidants and plant-based ALA (Alpha-Lipoic Acid). The high fat & fiber content of these pancakes and waffles will also help you with appetite control for the rest of the day ☀️.

Use our mix to make up to 14 decadent and filling pancakes for you & your family.

BAKING TIPS

For making pancakes:

  • Set griddle temperature to 375F
  • Keep pancakes small for ease of flipping - 2 heaping tablespoons of batter will make a 3.5-inch pancake.
  • Cooking time ranges between 2.5 to 3 minutes for first side and 1.5 to 2 minutes for second side

For making waffles:
  • Set temperature to medium-to-high.
  • Oil/spray the waffle iron grid plate, especially if not a nonstick surface.
  • Approx. 2 heaping tablespoons of batter makes one 4-inch square waffle. This size (or smaller) allows for easy removal and a faster cooking time.
  • Cooking time is 1.5 to 2 minutes.

description: Before there was a WoodenKnife Company there was the WoodenKnife Cafe in Interior, which has a view of the Badlands of South Dakota. Ansel took their advice and started the WoodenKnife manufacturing plant, located behind the cafe. As with any small business it took a lot of hard work. This option gives a small look into the Sioux Indian culture. Back when the Sioux Indians were still migrating with the buffalo, pouch bags were used to store and transport grain and other goods. The other packaging option, although more main stream still has a personal touch. Ansel personally designed the blue and yellow box himself, using hand-drawn artwork. The WoodenKnife Company has again taken on a new challenge. This one came about because food service providers were asking for a frozen dough. We at WoodenKnife are proud to announce that a frozen fry bread dough is now available with the same authentic taste that has made the original dry WoodenKnife Fry Bread Mix so popular.

description:
Perfect for your family's weekend breakfast with Multi-Color Pancakes. This Multi-Color Pancake Mix will turn your ordinary morning meal into a true feast of taste and color. Great taste and fun colors make these best-ever breakfast cakes a hit with both kids and adults alike.
Cooking Multi-Color Pancakes is easy and fun. Simply use the recipe below and follow step-by-step instructions.

To make Multi-Color Pancakes you will need the following ingredients:

  • 1 package of pancake mix
  • 0.18 pound - 85 grams of melted butter
  • 0.5 Cup\ 3.7 fl oz\ 110 milliliters of milk
  • 3 large eggs

    • Cooking instructions:

    1. Melt butter in a microwave for 30 seconds, set aside.

    2. In a small bowl whisk milk and eggs together.

    3. Add pancake mix into a large bowl.

    4. Pour melted butter and milk and eggs mixture into the bowl with the pancake mix.

    5. Using a whisk, mix all the ingredients into a batter just enough to bring it together. No need to mix the batter until all lumps are gone because they will dissolve naturally. The batter should be thick yet able to run slowly and nicely off of the spoon.

    6. Allow the batter to rest for a few minutes while heating a lightly oiled frying pan or a griddle to medium high heat.

    7. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake onto the griddle

    8. Cook each side for 3-6 minutes, until lightly golden-brown outside.

    9. .Enjoy

    This recipe makes approximately 8 to 10 pancakes (400g).

    Can this pancake recipe be used to make waffles?

description:
Let's be honest. Most of the gluten-free bread out there is crap. If you're living gluten-free, you're already familiar with sandwich bread recipes that turn out squat bricks with a cardboard texture. Then there's the mushy, gummy, Play Doh like variety. How about the gritty, dry, papery loaves that butter will not melt on? And let's not forget the ones with either no taste at all or a strange bean-y flavor. Eating gluten-free should not be a prison sentence. Absence of gluten should not equal absence of taste or eating pleasure. That's why we've spent countless hours creating a reliable recipe that makes a light- textured sandwich loaf (one actually large enough to slice for sandwiches). Our bread has an excellent crumb, a natural flavor and a golden-brown crust. It will stay moist for several days at room temperature and tastes good toasted for several more. In other words, we have tried to create something as close to "real" bread as possible. Mind you, we're not promising that you won't be able to tell the difference between our gluten-free bread and wheat-based bread. There's a name for companies that try to sell you that fantasy: liars. But what we can promise is that if you don't like our bread for any reason, you don't have to pay for it. So why not give it a try? You have nothing to lose-and a lifetime of health and freedom from gluten to gain. Allergy warning: contains dairy.

Seamos honestos. La mayor parte del pan sin gluten hay basura. Si estás viviendo sin gluten, ya estás familiarizado con recetas de pan sándwich que resultan ladrillos en cuclillas con una textura de cartón. Luego está la variedad blanda, gomosa, Play Doh. ¿Qué hay de los panes de papel crudo, seco en los que la mantequilla no se derretirá? Y no olvidemos los que no tienen sabor ni un extraño sabor a frijoles. Comer sin gluten no debe ser una pena de prisión. La ausencia de gluten no debe igualar la ausencia de sabor o placer de comer. Es por eso que hemos pasado incontables horas creando una receta confiable que hace un pan sándwich con textura ligera (una realmente lo suficientemente grande como para cortar para sándwiches). Nuestro pan tiene una excelente miga, un sabor natural y una corteza de color marrón dorado. Se mantendrá húmedo durante varios días a temperatura ambiente y tiene un buen sabor tostado por varios más. En otras palabras, hemos tratado de crear algo lo más cerca posible del pan "real". Ten en cuenta que no prometemos que no podrás distinguir entre nuestro pan sin gluten y el pan a base de trigo. Hay un nombre para las empresas que intentan venderte esa fantasía: mentirosos. בואו נהיה כנים. רוב הלחם ללא גלוטן יש חרא. אם אתה חי ללא גלוטן, אתה כבר מכיר מתכוני לחם סנדוויץ' שיהפכו לבנים סקוואטים עם מרקם קרטון. אז יש את ההרגשה הנוחה, הגומיק, Play Doh כמו מגוון. מה דעתך על כיכרות הנייר הגרגרניות, היבשות שהחמאה לא תימס עליהם? ובואו לא נשכח את אלה ללא טעם בכלל או בטעם פולי מוזר. אכילה ללא גלוטן לא צריכה להיות משפט בית כלא. העדר גלוטן לא צריך להיות בהעדר טעם או אכילה הנאה. לכן בילינו אינספור שעות ביצירת מתכון אמין שהופך כיכר כריך עם מרקם קל (אחד גדול מספיק כדי לחתוך לסנדוויצ'ם). ללחם שלנו יש פירורים מצוינים, טעם טבעי וקרום חום זהוב. הוא יישאר לח במשך כמה ימים בטמפרטורת החדר וטעם קלוי טוב לכמה נוספים. במילים אחרות, ניסינו ליצור משהו קרוב ככל האפשר ללחם "אמיתי". שימו לב, אנחנו לא מבטיחים שלא תוכלו להבחין בהבדל בין לחם ללא גלוטן שלנו לבין לחם מבוסס חיטה. יש שם לחברות שמנסות למכור לכם את הפנטזיה הזאת: שקרנים. אבל מה שאנחנו יכולים להבטיח הוא שאם אתם לא אוהבים את הלחם שלנו מכל סיבה שהיא, אתם לא צריכים לשלם על זה. אז למה לא לנסות את זה? אין לכם מה להפסיד - וחיים שלמים של בריאות וחופש מגלוטן ועד להרוויח. אזהרת אלרגיה: מכיל חלב.

Seien wir ehrlich. Das meiste glutenfreie Brot gibt es Crap. Wenn Sie glutenfrei leben, kennen Sie bereits Rezepte für Sandwichbrot, die Kniebeugen mit einer Kartonstruktur ausfallen. Und vergessen wir nicht jene, die keinen Geschmack haben oder einen seltsamen Bohnen-y-Geschmack. Glutenfrei essen sollte kein Gefängnissatz sein. Der Verzicht auf Gluten sollte nicht gleich fehlender Geschmack oder Essgenuss sein. Deshalb haben wir unzählige Stunden damit verbracht, ein zuverlässiges Rezept zu kreieren, das einen leicht strukturierten Sandwichlaib macht (einer tatsächlich groß genug, um Sandwiches zu schneiden). Unser Brot hat eine hervorragende Krümel, einen natürlichen Geschmack und eine goldbraune Kruste. Es bleibt bei Raumtemperatur mehrere Tage feucht und schmeckt gut geröstet für mehrere Tage. Mit anderen Worten, wir haben versucht, etwas so nah an "echtem" Brot wie möglich herzustellen. Es gibt einen Namen für Firmen, die versuchen, Ihnen diese Fantasie zu verkaufen: Lüger. Vamos ser honestos. A maioria dos pães sem glúten lá fora é uma porcaria. Se você está vivendo sem glúten, você já está familiarizado com receitas de pão sanduíche que acabam com blocos de agachamento com uma textura de papelão. Depois há a variedade de brinquedos Play Doh e gomos. E os pães ásperos, secos e de papel que a manteiga não derretem? E não vamos esquecer os que não têm gosto nem um sabor estranho. Comer sem glúten não deve ser uma sentença de prisão. A ausência de glúten não deve igualar a ausência de sabor ou prazer comer. É por isso que passamos incontáveis horas criando uma receita confiável que faz um pão sanduíche com textura leve (um na verdade grande o suficiente para fatiar sanduíches). Nosso pão tem uma excelente migalha, um sabor natural e uma crosta marrom dourada. Ele permanecerá úmido por vários dias em temperatura ambiente e tem bom gosto para vários outros. Em outras palavras, tentamos criar algo o mais próximo possível do pão "real". Não estamos prometendo que você não será capaz de dizer a diferença entre nossos pão sem glúten e pão à base de trigo. Há um nome para empresas que tentam vender essa fantasia: mentirosos. Mas o que podemos prometer é que, se você não gostar do nosso pão por qualquer motivo, você não precisa pagar por ele. Então, por que não experimentar? Você não tem nada a perder e uma vida inteira de saúde e liberdade de glúten para ganhar. Aviso sobre alergia: contém lactose.

솔직히 말해요. 대부분의 글루텐 프리 빵에는 쓰레기가 있습니다. 글루텐 프리로 살고 계신다면 판지 질감으로 스쿼트 벽돌을 만드는 샌드위치 빵 레시피에 익숙합니다. 그렇다면 부드럽고 젤리같은 플레이도우 같은 다양한 제품이 있습니다. 버터가 녹지 않는 거칠고 건조한 종이 덩어리는 어떻습니까? 그리고 전혀 맛이 없거나 이상한 콩 맛이 있는 것을 잊지 마세요. 글루텐 프리 먹는 것은 감옥 문장이 아닙니다. 글루텐이 없으면 맛이나 먹는 즐거움이 없어야 합니다. 그렇기 때문에 저희는 믿을 수 있는 레시피를 만드는 데 수많은 시간을 투자했습니다. (샌드위치를 썰기에 충분한 실제 샌드위치 로프). 저희 빵은 훌륭한 부스러기, 자연스러운 맛, 골드 브라운 크러스트를 가지고 있습니다. 실온에서 며칠 동안 촉촉하게 유지되며 여러 번 구운 맛이 좋습니다. 즉, 우리는 가능한 한 "진짜" 빵에 가까운 것을 만들려고 노력했습니다. 우리는 글루텐이 없는 빵과 밀 기반 빵의 차이를 알 수 없을 것이라고 약속하지 않습니다. 당신에게 그 판타지를 판매하려고 하는 회사의 이름이 있습니다: 거짓말 쟁이. 하지만 저희가 약속할 수 있는 것은 어떤 이유로든 저희 빵을 좋아하지 않는다면 돈을 지불할 필요가 없다는 것입니다. 그렇다면 한 번 입어보지 않으시겠습니까? 잃을 것이 없으며 평생 건강과 글루텐에서 얻을 수 있는 자유를 누릴 수 있습니다. 알레르기 경고: 유제품 포함.

description:
Become the pastry chef at home with our macaron baking mix. Makes 20 macarons.

From your pantry, you will need:
- 2 medium egg whites (65g)
Our tips to succeed with macarons!
Macarons can be tricky but with some tips you will be able to make them gorgeous and delicious.

1. Make sure your macarons don’t turn out grainy!
- Sifting the mix will take out any remaining pieces of almond or sugar.

2. Make a shiny meringue!
-Weigh your egg whites, we need 65g. It helps getting a better result.
- Separate the egg whites from the yolk 2 hours before making the macarons. And leave the egg whites at room temperature in a closed box. That helps them whip up better.

There are two kinds of meringue: the Italian meringue and the French meringue. The Italian meringue needs to add a heating syrup in the egg whites. The French meringue needs only sugar in the egg whites. We use French meringue, because we’re French! And because it’s way simpler to manage for beginners.

3. Macaronner ! (Folding the batter)
This French word means to fold the batter in a very specific way. This is a word we only use to mix the macaron batter. It is very important to do it properly, to mix enough but not too much.
Use a silicon spatula to slowly mix from the top to the bottom of the batter. Fold until you have a nice falling ribbon and are able to make a small 8 with the batter.

4. Pipping
- While you’re piping, you need to be straight: Your pastry bag should be perpendicular to your sheet pan.
- Your piping tip also need to be really near the sheet pan. Like that, the batter spreads more homogeneously, in a regular round shape.

5. The baking
To have a nice feet on your macaron, you can add a double layered baking sheet into your oven, at the bottom of your macarons plate.

description:
Oh yum!
Oh yum!

Your gluten free kitchen is going to smell sooooooooooo good. Your mouth is going to water. Neighbors you didn’t even know you had are going to come rapping at your door. Butter is going to kneel at your feet and melt in abject adoration. No kidding, these are some tasty, fresh-from-the-oven gluten free miracles. No matter how you slice it, your constitutional right to the perfect sandwich starts with the perfect gluten free bread. We’ve taken the liberty of making it easy, so you’re free to bake.

It’s your constitutional right...
  • A moist, rich sandwich bread made with rice flour and brown sugar
  • Great to make using a bread machine or by hand
  • Free from gluten and wheat, so your tummy stays happy
  • Contains no cholesterol or transfat, so you can enjoy your sandwich guilt free

Glutino Gluten Free Pantry Favorite Sandwich Bread Mix
It’s all part of the bounty of a gluten free life. Live fully.

To embrace a gluten free life is to embrace a bountiful life. A life filled with possibility and opportunity. A life unhampered by “can’t,” “don’t,” and “won’t”. A life where our bodies and hearts and minds are balanced and in tune. For many of us, living gluten free means living agony-free. For others, living gluten free allows us to perform at the top of our game. And for an ever increasing number of us, living gluten free just plain feels good.

And living is what it’s all about. Living every day with joy, freedom, and confidence. On our own terms. In our own way. It’s not a question of whether our glass is half-empty or half-full, because our glass — like our lives — is overflowing. But there can be side effects to living gluten free. Chronic euphoria is pretty common. You might experience regular bouts of giddiness along with a skin condition we like to refer to as the gluten free glow. If symptoms persist, try not to gloat.

“I will never go back to eating gluten.”

We hear that a lot from our customers. We like to think that it’s because Glutino foods are just so dang yummy. We know it goes deeper than that. We think it has to do with the power you feel. You feel empowered by the control you now have over what you take into your body. You feel the power of awareness of how the food you eat makes you feel. That’s the power of getting your life back. description: The Yukon culture is one of Sourdough International’s collection of more than 16 authentic sourdough cultures from around the world. The wonderful flavor it produced inspired Ed Wood to search Europe and the Middle East for other sourdoughs. The Yukon starter is moderately sour and performs well for traditional sourdough flapjacks, pancakes and waffles. Refrigerated sourdough cultures become dormant but stay viable for many months requiring feeding only to reactivate them before use. The included instructions describe in detail how to activate, reactivate and use our cultures. Ed Wood’s most recent book “Classic Sourdoughs, Revised” contains detailed information for using, maintaining and being successful with sourdough cultures. All of our cultures can be used with any of the available home bread machines if used as Ed does for mixing and kneading only. Most bread machines are unsuitable for baking authentic sourdoughs since they do not have “bake only” cycles and thus do not permit the long fermentation cycles required to produce the sourdough flavor.

description:
Low in carbohydrates and high in fiber and protein, Bake In A Minute – Bread mix and more is excellent for individuals leading or looking to follow a low carb, ketogenic, paleo, vegetarian or vegan diet. As well as anyone looking to eat a more healthy, low ingredient and natural foods, to lose or maintain their current weight. Bake In A Minute – Bread mix and more takes the guesswork out of baking, in one easy, convenient mix that is delicious and versatile. From pizza to pancakes, muffins to 90 second mug breads, Bake In A Minute is easy to work with and very forgiving, making it easy to get creative with your recipes.

Bake In A Minute Simple Recipes

Original Mug Bread

25g (¼ cup) Bake In A Minute mix

1 whole egg (white of the egg works as well)

1 tbsp. butter/oil.

Mix all ingredients above, in a microwave safe mug or small bowl.

Microwave on high for 90 seconds. (microwave times may vary)



Easy Mini-Bread Loaf

(Preheat oven to 350F.)

100g (1 cup) of Bake In A Minute

2 - 3 eggs (preference)

4 tbsp butter/oil

Mix all ingredients above in a bowl.

Place in a parchment lined or buttered loaf pan. A mini-loaf pan will also work well.

Bake at 350F for approx. 25 min. or until a toothpick comes out clean.

Bread loaf may come out flatter in a regular size loaf pan. A full size loaf is 200g of mix.



Pizza Crust (Preheat oven to 350F.)

100g (1 cup) Bake In A Minute mix

2 eggs

4 tbsp butter/oil

Mix all ingredients above, in a bowl.

Spread dough on parchment lined cookie sheet and flatten with a rolling pin.

Bake for 8-10 min.

Spread sauce, cheese and add your favorite toppings.

Bake for another 5 minutes or until toppings are heated through and cheese has melted.

Bake for additional 3-5 min. for a crispier crust.

description: My name is Lindsay Frucci and I am a brownieholic. I love thick, fudgy, chewy brownies. I hate fat. In my food or on my hips, fat is something I like to live without. Since most thick, fudgy, chewy brownies are loaded with fat this created quite a problem. Were brownies without guilt a possibility? In January of 1995, I decided to try and find out. Since my family and I had already tried and rejected several commercially available fat free brownies (they either tasted like fruit or had no taste at all), I decided to see if I could come up with my own fat free brownie recipe. During the next few weeks, I made and threw away more pans of brownies than most people make in a lifetime. Fortunately, we were having some remodeling done on our home at the time and the two builders who were doing the work were only too happy to be my "official" taste testers. They took their mission very seriously, carefully evaluating every batch of fat free brownies for taste and texture. By the time the remodeling was done, I had a recipe for fat free brownies that were chewy, very rich and fudgy, and, best of all, FAT FREE I knew that I wanted to turn the recipe into a company, but with a background that included pediatric nursing and being a Mom, I had absolutely no idea how... Enter my local SCORE (Service Corps of Retired Executives) office. There, I was incredibly lucky to be connected with two wonderful gentlemen who had had extensive experience in the food industry. With their expertise and guidance, No Pudge! Foods was begun. FAT FREE Original Fudge Brownie Mix first appeared on the shelves of a few New Hampshire stores in August of 1995.

description: My name is Lindsay Frucci and I am a brownieholic. I love thick, fudgy, chewy brownies. I hate fat. In my food or on my hips, fat is something I like to live without. Since most thick, fudgy, chewy brownies are loaded with fat this created quite a problem. Were brownies without guilt a possibility? In January of 1995, I decided to try and find out. Since my family and I had already tried and rejected several commercially available fat free brownies (they either tasted like fruit or had no taste at all), I decided to see if I could come up with my own fat free brownie recipe. During the next few weeks, I made and threw away more pans of brownies than most people make in a lifetime. Fortunately, we were having some remodeling done on our home at the time and the two builders who were doing the work were only too happy to be my "official" taste testers. They took their mission very seriously, carefully evaluating every batch of fat free brownies for taste and texture. By the time the remodeling was done, I had a recipe for fat free brownies that were chewy, very rich and fudgy, and, best of all, FAT FREE I knew that I wanted to turn the recipe into a company, but with a background that included pediatric nursing and being a Mom, I had absolutely no idea how... Enter my local SCORE (Service Corps of Retired Executives) office. There, I was incredibly lucky to be connected with two wonderful gentlemen who had had extensive experience in the food industry. With their expertise and guidance, No Pudge! Foods was begun. FAT FREE Original Fudge Brownie Mix first appeared on the shelves of a few New Hampshire stores in August of 1995.

description: With the Koopmans stroopwafel cake baking mix you can make a delicious cake for yourself or to hand out to friends and family. Baking cake is very easy with this cake mix! Are you going to bake with children for an afternoon soon? read the instructions on the package together and make the cake even better by adding some ingredients yourself. This mix for cake is even more delicious with a spoonful of homemade caramel sauce and you can decorate the cake after baking with sprinkles and other decorations! DIRECTIONS: Requirements: 1 pack of Koopmans Old-Dutch Stroopwafel cake, 200 g butter or margarine, 4 eggs (medium-sized), 4 stroopwafels (all at room temperature) Oven temperature: Electric oven: 160oC Preparation 1. Place the grid slightly below the center of the oven and heat the oven. 2. Grease the cake tin with butter and dust the inside lightly with flour. 3. Beat the butter with the mixer in a mixing bowl until soft and creamy. Add the cake mix and eggs in one go. 5. Stir everything with the mixer on the lowest setting for ½ minute until smooth. 6. Then beat the batter with the mixer on the highest setting for 2 minutes to a light batter. 7. Cut 2 stroopwafels into small pieces of about 1 cm and mix them through the batter with a spatula. 8. Put the batter in the cake tin and smooth the batter. 9. Cut the remaining 2 stroopwafels into small pieces of 1 cm and divide them over the cake. 10. Bake the cake in about 60 - 70 minutes until done and golden brown. 11. Place the cake in the tin on a grid, put a tea towel over the cake and let the cake cool in the tin for 30 minutes. 12. Remove the cake from the tin and let it cool down on a wire rack. 13. Only when the cake has cooled completely, you can carefully cut it with a large knife with fine serrations (bread knife)

There is really no better way to start your day. A plate full of delicate crepes filled or rolled with your favorite toppings. What dreams are made of.

description:
Low in carbohydrates and high in fiber and protein, Bake In A Minute – Bread mix and more is excellent for individuals leading or looking to follow a low carb, ketogenic, paleo, vegetarian or vegan diet. As well as anyone looking to eat a more healthy, low ingredient and natural foods, to lose or maintain their current weight. Bake In A Minute – Bread mix and more takes the guesswork out of baking, in one easy, convenient mix that is delicious and versatile. From pizza to pancakes, muffins to 90 second mug breads, Bake In A Minute is easy to work with and very forgiving, making it easy to get creative with your recipes.

Bake In A Minute Simple Recipes

Original Mug Bread

25g (¼ cup) Bake In A Minute mix

1 whole egg (white of the egg works as well)

1 tbsp. butter/oil.

Mix all ingredients above, in a microwave safe mug or small bowl.

Microwave on high for 90 seconds. (microwave times may vary)



Easy Mini-Bread Loaf

(Preheat oven to 350F.)

100g (1 cup) of Bake In A Minute

2 - 3 eggs (preference)

4 tbsp butter/oil

Mix all ingredients above in a bowl.

Place in a parchment lined or buttered loaf pan. A mini-loaf pan will also work well.

Bake at 350F for approx. 25 min. or until a toothpick comes out clean.

Bread loaf may come out flatter in a regular size loaf pan. A full size loaf is 200g of mix.



Pizza Crust (Preheat oven to 350F.)

100g (1 cup) Bake In A Minute mix

2 eggs

4 tbsp butter/oil

Mix all ingredients above, in a bowl.

Spread dough on parchment lined cookie sheet and flatten with a rolling pin.

Bake for 8-10 min.

Spread sauce, cheese and add your favorite toppings.

Bake for another 5 minutes or until toppings are heated through and cheese has melted.

Bake for additional 3-5 min. for a crispier crust.

description:
Perfect for your family's weekend breakfast with Multi-Color Pancakes. This Multi-Color Pancake Mix will turn your ordinary morning meal into a true feast of taste and color. Great taste and fun colors make these best-ever breakfast cakes a hit with both kids and adults alike.
Cooking Multi-Color Pancakes is easy and fun. Simply use the recipe below and follow step-by-step instructions.

To make Multi-Color Pancakes you will need the following ingredients:

  • 1 package of pancake mix
  • 0.18 pound - 85 grams of melted butter
  • 0.5 Cup\ 3.7 fl oz\ 110 milliliters of milk
  • 3 large eggs

    • Cooking instructions:

    1. Melt butter in a microwave for 30 seconds, set aside.

    2. In a small bowl whisk milk and eggs together.

    3. Add pancake mix into a large bowl.

    4. Pour melted butter and milk and eggs mixture into the bowl with the pancake mix.

    5. Using a whisk, mix all the ingredients into a batter just enough to bring it together. No need to mix the batter until all lumps are gone because they will dissolve naturally. The batter should be thick yet able to run slowly and nicely off of the spoon.

    6. Allow the batter to rest for a few minutes while heating a lightly oiled frying pan or a griddle to medium high heat.

    7. Pour 1/4 cup batter for each pancake onto the griddle

    8. Cook each side for 3-6 minutes, until lightly golden-brown outside.

    9. .Enjoy

    This recipe makes approximately 8 to 10 pancakes (400g).

    Can this pancake recipe be used to make waffles?
    Yes!

    Can this pancake recipe be made into mini pancakes or "silver dollar"pancakes?
    Yes!

    Yes!

When you bake herbal brownies, the oven hits 350° and at that temperature a certain amount of your herbs will vaporize and bake off. description:
Preparation: pancakes: 1. Gently whisk together egg, oil and water. 2. Fold in mix until combined. (Don't over-mix - lumps are okay!) 3. Cook over medium-high heat on a preheated, greased skillet about 3 minutes per side or until lightly browned. Waffles: follow pancake instructions for batter, but double the water. Cook according to waffle iron instructions. Make it vegan: replace 1 egg, add 1/3 cup mashed bananas.

Preparación: panqueques: 1. Batir suavemente el huevo, el aceite y el agua. 2. Doble en mezcla hasta que se combine. (No mezcle excesivamente - los grumos están bien!) 3. Cocine a fuego medio-alto en una sartén engrasada precalentada unos 3 minutos por lado o hasta que esté ligeramente dorada. Waffles: siga las instrucciones de panqueques para la masa, pero el doble del agua. Cocine de acuerdo con las instrucciones de gofres. Hazlo vegano: reemplazar 1 huevo, añadir 1/3 taza de puré de plátanos.

Zubereitung: Pfannkuchen: 1. Rühren Sie Ei, Öl und Wasser sanft zusammen. 2. Mix zusammenfalten bis kombiniert. (Vermischen Sie nicht – Klumpen sind okay). 3. Bei mittlerer Hitze auf einer vorgeheizten, gefetteten Bratpfanne ca. 3 Minuten pro Seite oder bis leicht gebräunt. Waffel: Folgen Sie Pfannkuchenanweisungen für Teig, aber verdoppeln Sie das Wasser. Kochen Sie nach Anleitung des Waffeleisens. Machen Sie es vegan: Ersetzen Sie 1 Ei, fügen Sie 1/3 Tasse pürierte Bananen hinzu.

הכנה: פנקייק: 1. מקציפים בעדינות ביצה, שמן ומים. 2. קפלו את התערובת עד לשילוב. (אל תערבבו יתר על המידה - הגושים בסדר!) 3. לבשל על חום בינוני-גבוה על מחבת מחוממת מראש ומשומנת בערך 3 דקות בכל צד או עד להשחמה קלה. וופלים: עקוב אחר הוראות הפנקייק לבלילה, אבל הכפיל את המים. לבשל לפי הוראות ברזל וופל. הפכו אותו לטבעוני: החליפו ביצה אחת, הוסיפו 1/3 כוס בננות ממחת.

الإعداد: الفطائر: 1. خفق البيض والزيت والماء. 2. قم بطيه في المزيج حتى يتم دمجه. (لا تفرط في الخلط - الكتل على ما يبئ!) 3. اطبخ على درجة حرارة متوسطة عالية على مقلاة مسبقة التسخين ومشحومة حوالي 3 دقائق لكل جانب أو حتى يصبح لونه بني خفيف. وافل: اتبع تعليمات الفطائر الخاصة بالخليط ولكن ضاعف الماء. قم بالطهي وفقًا لتعليمات حديد الوافل. اجعلها نباتية: استبدل بيضة واحدة، وأضف 1/3 كوب من الموز المهروس.

Preparação: panquecas: 1. Misture suavemente o ovo, óleo e água. 2. Dobre na mistura até combinar. (Não misture demais – os pedaços estão bem!) 3. Cozinhe em temperatura média em uma frigideira pré-aquecida e lubrificada cerca de 3 minutos por lado ou até ficar levemente marrom. Waffles: siga as instruções de panqueca para massa, mas o dobro da água. Cozinhe de acordo com as instruções de ferro em forma de Torne vegana: substitua 1 ovo, adicione 1/3 xícara de bananas trituradas.

準備:煎餅:1. 輕輕攪拌雞蛋、油和水。 2. 混合折疊,直到組合。 (不要過度混合 - 腫塊沒關係!) 3. 在預先加熱的油煎鍋上以中高溫烹飪,每側約 3 分鐘,或直至淺褐色。 華夫餅:按照煎餅說明製作麵糊,但雙倍水。 按照鬆餅熨斗說明烹飪。 讓它成為純素:更換 1 個雞蛋,加入 1/3 杯香蕉泥。

制作:煎饼:1 将鸡蛋、油和水轻轻搅打。 2. 混合折叠直到组合为止。 (不要过度混合 - 肿块没问题!) 3. 用预热的涂油煎锅进行中等高温烹饪,每边约3分钟或直到轻微棕色。 华夫饼:按照煎饼说明制作面糊,但将水加倍。 根据华夫饼熨斗说明进行烹饪。 素食:代替 1 个鸡蛋,加入 1/3 杯香蕉泥。

준비: 팬케이크: 1. 계란, 기름, 물을 부드럽게 털어냅니다. 2. 결합될 때까지 섞어서 접으세요. (너무 섞지 마십시오 - 덩어리는 괜찮습니다!) 3. 예열된 기름칠 프라이팬에 중간 고온으로 요리하거나 한 면당 약 3분 정도 또는 가볍게 갈색으로 칠할 때까지 요리하십시오. 와플: 반죽을 위해 팬케이크 지침을 따르지만 물은 두 배입니다. 와플 아이언 지침에 따라 요리하십시오. 비건 만들기: 계란 1개를 교체하고, 으깬 바나나 1/3컵을 추가합니다.

description:
Make any moment memorable when you serve a stack of pancakes made with our Aunt Jemima Original Pancake & Waffle Mix. They’re perfectly fluffy, contain no artificial coloring or flavors.

Our History: It is the start of a new day: Aunt Jemima is now Pearl Milling Company. Though the Brand is new to store shelves, the name itself has been a part of our story for over 130 years. Pearl Milling Company was a small mill in the bustling town of St. Joseph, Missouri. Using a pearl milling technique, they produced flour, cornmeal, and, beginning in 1889, the famous self-rising pancake mix that would go on to be known as Aunt Jemima.

Amount in the mix: When prepared as directed with 1egg, 1 Tbsp veg oil, and 3/4 cup 2% milk, a serving of pancakes contains 190 Cal, 6g Total Fat (1.5g Saturated Fat), 60mg Cholesterol, 640mg Sodium, 28g Total Carbohydrate (<1g Fiber, 6g sugars) 6g Protein, 0mcg Vitamin D, 200mg Calcium, 1.7mg Iron, 110mg Potassium, 0.18mg Thiamin, 0.2mg Riboflavin, 1.6mg Niacin, 80mcg Folate (46 mcg Folic Acid), and 250mg Phosphorus. Percent Daily Values are based on a 2,000 calorie diet.

Pancake Prep Tips:

  • Check the freshness date on the package. Pancakes won't rise properly if the leavening is outdated.
  • Heat skillet over medium-low heat or heat an electric griddle to 375°F.
  • Combine all ingredients according to package directions. Add COLD water for extra fluffy pancakes.
  • Stir with a wire whisk until LARGE lumps disappear. Over mixing may toughen pancakes. Let stand 1-2 minutes to thicken.
  • Pour slightly less than 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake onto a lightly greased and heated skillet. Using an ice cream scoop helps make round pancakes.
  • Turn the pancakes when they begin to bubble and the bottoms are golden brown. Turn only once.

description: It gets cold in New England. So it's not surprising that New Englanders make bread with substance. Grains can be used in bread in four forms: As flours--though only wheat flour has the proteins to form gluten, which gives bread it's chewy, elastic texture. As rolled grains. Rolled oats and other rolled grains meld into the bread but make the bread chewy and moist. As finely chopped grains. Finely chopped grains may be the consistency of coarse salt but cook soft and nearly unnoticeable. They give the bread a chewy, hearty texture with occasional grains. As coarsely chopped grains. Coarsely chopped grains are distinct, chewy nuggets in the bread. Often, they are presoaked to make them softer. In a bread machine, with a three-hour cycle, the grains are softened. The grains in this bread are finely chopped. They bake soft and chewy, with a hardy and wholesome texture yet the bread is still soft and moist. The bread is nearly white so the kids will accept it as one of their favorites. A great bread for toast and sandwiches. A soft, moist bread that your family will love. Don't miss this great bread. description: Great River Organic Milling is located on the upper Mississippi River, in the heart of what is called the Hiawatha Valley. The natural beauty of the area is a constant reminder of the importance of our commitment to organic agriculture. Organic, or sustainable agriculture is more than the avoidance of chemical fertilizers and pesticides. An organic farm strives to protect our environment by building and maintaining healthy soil which, in turn, improves water and air quality. It has been shown that grain and other food crops grown in a healthy soil, resist pests and diseases better than conventionally grown crops and also contain more vital nutrients important to humans. Consuming organic foods promotes the health of individuals and the land on which it was grown. In supporting organic agriculture we promote the cycle of a healthy environment which includes the lives of microorganisms, plants, and humans. Most Great River flour is stone-ground. We believe the natural granite millstones contribute to the quality, taste and nutritional integrity of whole grain flour. Grain flowing into the stones becomes very thin, flat flakes which integrates all parts of the wheat immediately into the flour, allowing the flour to have more flavor. The cooler temperatures that occur during milling with stones allows important enzyme activity to continue. Protein levels are also be maintained. Our stone-ground flours are milled to order, to retain the nutritional value of the flour. Great River is Certified Organic by Quality Assurance International and Kosher approved. Obtaining our certification requires a yearly inspection of our milling facility and records to insure that our products meet industry standards.

It Started with Dessert.

The legacy of Marie Callender began in the early 1940s in Orange County, California, when Marie launched her legendary business, delivering freshly baked goods to area restaurants. By 1948 with the help of her husband Cal and son Don, they turned their home-based bakery into a bona fide business.

Their first coffee shop was opened in 1964 in Orange, California, by Marie's son, Don. Other shops soon followed and in 1969, the coffee shops became full-service restaurants with many recipes created by Marie herself. Today, Marie Callender's operates 28 restaurants in the United States.

And while many things have changed, one thing will always remain the same - the quality and care that goes into making each and every one of our legendary baked goods. And for that, we can all be thankful.

The legacy of Marie Callender began in the early 1940s in Orange County, California, when Marie launched her legendary business, delivering freshly baked goods to area restaurants. By 1948 with the help of her husband Cal and son Don, they turned their home-based bakery into a bona fide business.

 , Não contém glúten]
description:
The Cheese Bread is a typical Brazilian preparation, being found in the recipe books in all regions of Brazil. Its basic ingredients are manioc starch, eggs and cheese. The main characteristics of this products are the crunchiness of the crust and the softness of the dough, it also has a very pleasant cheese and manioc flavor. It is usually eaten as an appetizer in restaurants, with tea and specially with a delicious cup of coffee.
The Amafil Cheese Bread is very easily done, does not demand special skills and has all the characteristics of a home made cheese bread.

- Similar to Yoki Cheese Bread Mix (Discontinued by the manufacturer)
- Does not contain gluten
- Easy to prepare
- Great for breakfast or as an appetizer
 

How to prepare:
Recipe for 17.6 oz of Amafil Cheese Bread Mix

1 - Place in a bowl 17.6 oz of Amafil Cheese Bread Mix. Add 4 medium eggs and 7 oz of shredded cheese (preferably mozzarella cheese). Knead well.

2 - Add little by little 6.8 fl. oz of water (room temperature), mixing well until dough is uniform and sticky on the hand but not to the bowl.

3 - Divide the dough, make balls in the desired size and place in flat pans. If necessary, grease hands with butter.

4 - Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until the cheese bread are lighly browned.

Makes 35 units of 1 oz each approximately.

title: Cinnamon Chip English Muffin Mix (3 lb 3 oz bulk bag)
description: Now you can make English muffins just like the restaurants'--only better. And it's easy. This is how you do it. Mix the batter according to directions. You will add only water and a bit of shortening. Stir until blended, cover and let rest for about 40 minutes. This will give the yeast included in the mix a chance to work. Stir 1/4 cup cinnamon chips. Heat your griddle. Place English muffin or other rings on the griddle. Scoop a third of a cup of batter into each ring. Let them cook for about eight minutes and then turn them over. When done, pop the rings off and you have genuine English muffins. You're ready to place the rings on the griddle and start another batch. Your English muffins will have the trademark texture, moist crumb, and rich taste of English muffins but they will be better because you made them. Toasted, they will have lots of crunch. The ABC’s in Making Meringue

A. Use a glass or metal bowl. Very clean and dry. No oil residue.

B. Whip in mixer for 9-12 minutes until there are stiff peaks. Scrape bowl as needed.

C. Add flavoring

For Meringue Cookies: (recipe for 8 cookies, entire bag makes 24 cookies)

1. In bowl use 1/4 cup water & 1/2 cup mix.
2. Follow the ABC’s of meringue above.
3. Pipe cookies out in a pastry bag.
4. Bake in preheated 250 deg oven for 40-45 minutes or until firm.
5. Turn off oven (do not open oven door).
6. Leave inside oven to cool for 1 hour.

For Meringue on top of a pie:

1. In bowl use 1/2 cup water and 1 cup mix.
2. Follow the ABC’s of meringue above.
3. Spread on top of the pie crust.
4. Bake in preheated 350 deg oven for 9-11 minutes or until meringue is golden brown.

For Pavlova:

1. In bowl use 1/2 cup water and 1 cup mix.
2. Follow the ABC’s of meringue above.
3. Bake in preheated 250 deg oven for 1.5 hrs
4. Turn off oven (do not open oven door) .
5. Leave inside oven to cool for 1 hour.

RECIPE: Absolutely Almond Thumbprint Cookies Recipe
The perfect holiday cookie that your little ones will love to help with!

Hands On:10 minutes Ready In: 25 minutes

Recipe Ingredients:
1 package Absolutely Almond Pound Cake Mix
½ cup butter, softened
1 large egg, beaten
1-1½ tablespoons water 
½ cup Rhubarb Strawberry Fruit Spread

Directions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F. In large bowl, combine Absolutely Almond Pound Cake Mix, butter and egg; mix until well combined.
2. Using hands, knead until the consistency of thick, moist dough. Form into generous 1-inch balls.
3. Place 2 inches apart on a greased large baking sheet. Bake 10 minutes. Remove from oven; using back of a teaspoon or thumb, make a round indentation in each cookie. Fill with Rhubarb Strawberry Fruit Spread. Continue baking 4-6 minutes or until lightly browned.

Makes 8-10 servings.

The ABC’s in Making Meringue

A. Use a glass or metal bowl. Very clean and dry. No oil residue.

B. Whip in mixer for 9-12 minutes until there are stiff peaks. Scrape bowl as needed.

C. Add flavoring

For Meringue Cookies: (recipe for 8 cookies, entire bag makes 24 cookies)

1. In bowl use 1/4 cup water & 1/2 cup mix.
2. Follow the ABC’s of meringue above.
3. Pipe cookies out in a pastry bag.
4. Bake in preheated 250 deg oven for 40-45 minutes or until firm.
5. Turn off oven (do not open oven door).
6. Leave inside oven to cool for 1 hour.

For Meringue on top of a pie:

1. In bowl use 1/2 cup water and 1 cup mix.
2. Follow the ABC’s of meringue above.
3. Spread on top of the pie crust.
4. Bake in preheated 350 deg oven for 9-11 minutes or until meringue is golden brown.

description:
Make any moment memorable when you serve a stack of pancakes made with our Aunt Jemima Original Complete Pancake & Waffle Mix. They’re perfectly fluffy, contain no artificial coloring or flavors, and are a good source of calcium and iron, so you can feel good about serving them to your family.

Our History: It is the start of a new day: Aunt Jemima is now Pearl Milling Company. Though the Brand is new to store shelves, the name itself has been a part of our story for over 130 years. Pearl Milling Company was a small mill in the bustling town of St. Joseph, Missouri. Using a pearl milling technique, they produced flour, cornmeal, and, beginning in 1889, the famous self-rising pancake mix that would go on to be known as Aunt Jemima. Our pancakes have been bringing smiles to the breakfast table ever since.

Amount in the mix: When prepared as directed with 1egg, 1 Tbsp veg oil, and 3/4 cup 2% milk, a serving of pancakes contains 190 Cal, 6g Total Fat (1.5g Saturated Fat), 60mg Cholesterol, 640mg Sodium, 28g Total Carbohydrate (<1g Fiber, 6g sugars) 6g Protein, 0mcg Vitamin D, 200mg Calcium, 1.7mg Iron, 110mg Potassium, 0.18mg Thiamin, 0.2mg Riboflavin, 1.6mg Niacin, 80mcg Folate (46 mcg Folic Acid), and 250mg Phosphorus. Percent Daily Values are based on a 2,000 calorie diet.

Preparation Instructions:

What You'll Need

  • 2 Cups Mix
  • 1 1/2 Cups Cold Water

What You'll Do

  • Heat skillet over medium-low heat or electric griddle to 375° F.
  • Combine all ingredients and stir until large lumps disappear (do not beat or over mix). Let stand 3-4 minutes to thicken.
  • Pour slightly less than 1/4 cup batter for each pancake onto lightly greased skillet.
  • Turn when pancakes bubble and bottoms are golden brown.

DIRECTIONS: Easy Drop Biscuits: Preheat oven to 450 F. Pour approximately 2 cups of mix in bowl and add ~3/4 cup of water and mix using as few strokes as possible to moisten dough. Scones and Tea, Steeped in Tradition

Want to experience afternoon tea? Take a trip to some of Britain’s quaint tearooms or London’s fine hotels where you’ll be served scones, jam and clotted cream - plus hot sweet tea in china teacups. When Sticky Fingers realized how popular their scones were, they recreated their scones in a mix that anyone could make at home. The most important ingredient was quality. description: Paradise Fruit Company was incorporated in 1961 as part of Canaveral Utilities and Development Co., a land development operation on the east coast of Florida. The name "Paradise", a label used by a company that had been in the 'glace' (candied) fruit business since the end of WW2, was acquired by Canaveral during the year of incorporation. After several acquisitions and mergers with similar businesses, 'glace' fruit became the major segment of the company's business. In 1965, the name was changed to Paradise Fruit Company, Inc. During those years, there were a number of relatively small operations manufacturing candied fruit, primarily for sale to commercial bakers. The management of Paradise anticipated that there was a great potential for direct sales to homemakers through supermarkets. Over a period of several years, Paradise developed the now familiar transparent, reusable plastic containers found in almost every supermarket during the holiday season. In order to become more immediately responsive to its customers needs, the company invested in a facility to manufacture all of its packaging. This, combined with large inventories, enabled almost overnight filling and shipping of orders. During the same period, the company acquired, merged with, or was licensed by a number of competitors to become the leading marketer of 'glace' fruit products under labels that have been trusted and asked for by customers for generations. Given the increasing diversification, the name of the company was changed to Paradise, Inc. in 1993. Paradise remains an innovator in 'glace' fruit marketing, introducing in 2003 a new package design that incorporates recipes and a cash-redeemable coupon.

description:

How to prepare:
Recipe for 17.6 oz of Amafil Cheese Bread Mix

1 - Place in a bowl 17.6 oz of Amafil Cheese Bread Mix. Add 4 medium eggs and 7 oz of shredded cheese (preferably mozzarella cheese). Knead well.

2 - Add little by little 6.8 fl. oz of water (room temperature), mixing well until dough is uniform and sticky on the hand but not to the bowl.

3 - Divide the dough, make balls in the desired size and place in flat pans. If necessary, grease hands with butter.

4 - Preheat oven to 350 degrees F. Bake in the preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until the cheese bread are lighly browned.

Makes 35 units of 1 oz each approximately.

נוסדה בשנת 2011, Matt וחברתה עכשיו, ליזי יצאה לבנות תערובת פנקייק ופל טבעית טעימה ומנוקה. הצמד ניסוי עם כל מרכיב שבו השתמשו, ובסופו של דבר עם הפנקייק והטעים ביותר עם תוספת מים בלבד ומערבבי וופל שניתן להעלות על הדעת.



تأسست ليزي في عام 2011، بدأ في بناء خليط الفطائر والوافل اللذيذ والمنظف بشكل طبيعي. تم اختبار الثنائي مع كل مكون استخدموه، وانتهى به الأمر بمزيج من الفطائر والوافل الأكثر رقة والمذاق الذي يمكن تخيله.



Fundada em 2011, Matt e sua então namorada e agora esposa, Lizzi começaram a construir uma mistura de panqueca e waffle naturalmente deliciosa e limpa. A dupla experimentou todos os ingredientes usados e acabou com as misturas mais fofas e saborosas de panquecas e waffle imagináveis.



Matt 和他當時的女朋友現任妻子 Lizzi 創立於 2011 年,開始打造自然美味、清潔的鬆餅和鬆餅混合。 這款二人組實驗了他們使用的每個成分,並最終產生了最蓬鬆、最美味、只需加水煎餅和鬆餅混合。



Lizzi 于 2011 年成立,马特和他当时的女朋友现在的妻子创立了一种自然美味的煎饼和华夫饼混合物。 这组双人组合对他们使用的每种配料进行了试验,最终制作了蓬松、美味、刚加入水的煎饼和华夫饼混合物。



2011년에 설립된 Matt와 그의 당시 여자친구인 지금의 부인, Lizzi는 자연스럽게 맛있고 깨끗한 팬케이크와 와플 믹스를 만들기 시작했습니다. 듀오는 그들이 사용하는 모든 재료를 실험했고, 가장 푹신하고 맛있는 저물 팬케이크 및 와플 믹스로 끝났습니다.

description:

Weisenberger’s Spoon Bread offers a rich, sweet corn flavor with the moist, soft texture of true, old fashioned spoon bread. Stone ground corn meal is combined with dry eggs and milk, shortening, and other essential ingredients in perfect proportions for an easy to use mix you can make in minutes. Bake In A Minute – Bread mix and more takes the guesswork out of baking, in one easy, convenient mix that is delicious and versatile. From pizza to pancakes, muffins to 90 second mug breads, Bake In A Minute is easy to work with and very forgiving, making it easy to get creative with your recipes.

Bake In A Minute Simple Recipes

Original Mug Bread

25g (¼ cup) Bake In A Minute mix

1 whole egg (white of the egg works as well)

1 tbsp. butter/oil.

Mix all ingredients above, in a microwave safe mug or small bowl.

Microwave on high for 90 seconds. (microwave times may vary)



Easy Mini-Bread Loaf

(Preheat oven to 350F.)

100g (1 cup) of Bake In A Minute

2 - 3 eggs (preference)

4 tbsp butter/oil

Mix all ingredients above in a bowl.

Place in a parchment lined or buttered loaf pan. A mini-loaf pan will also work well.

Bake at 350F for approx. 25 min. or until a toothpick comes out clean.

Bread loaf may come out flatter in a regular size loaf pan. A full size loaf is 200g of mix.



Pizza Crust (Preheat oven to 350F.)

100g (1 cup) Bake In A Minute mix

2 eggs

4 tbsp butter/oil

Mix all ingredients above, in a bowl.

Spread dough on parchment lined cookie sheet and flatten with a rolling pin.

Bake for 8-10 min.

Spread sauce, cheese and add your favorite toppings.

Bake for another 5 minutes or until toppings are heated through and cheese has melted.

Bake for additional 3-5 min. for a crispier crust.

Everyone Who Steps into the Kitchen is a Professional Chef

Cornbread is an American tradition, and Marie Callender’s is part of that tradition with perfect cornbread every time.

It Started with Dessert.

The legacy of Marie Callender began in the early 1940s in Orange County, California, when Marie launched her legendary business, delivering freshly baked goods to area restaurants. By 1948 with the help of her husband Cal and son Don, they turned their home-based bakery into a bona fide business.

Their first coffee shop was opened in 1964 in Orange, California, by Marie's son, Don. Other shops soon followed and in 1969, the coffee shops became full-service restaurants with many recipes created by Marie herself. Today, Marie Callender's operates 28 restaurants in the United States.

And while many things have changed, one thing will always remain the same - the quality and care that goes into making each and every one of our legendary baked goods. And for that, we can all be thankful.

description: My name is Lindsay Frucci and I am a brownieholic. I love thick, fudgy, chewy brownies. I hate fat. In my food or on my hips, fat is something I like to live without. Since most thick, fudgy, chewy brownies are loaded with fat this created quite a problem. Were brownies without guilt a possibility? In January of 1995, I decided to try and find out. Since my family and I had already tried and rejected several commercially available fat free brownies (they either tasted like fruit or had no taste at all), I decided to see if I could come up with my own fat free brownie recipe. During the next few weeks, I made and threw away more pans of brownies than most people make in a lifetime. Fortunately, we were having some remodeling done on our home at the time and the two builders who were doing the work were only too happy to be my "official" taste testers. They took their mission very seriously, carefully evaluating every batch of fat free brownies for taste and texture. By the time the remodeling was done, I had a recipe for fat free brownies that were chewy, very rich and fudgy, and, best of all, FAT FREE I knew that I wanted to turn the recipe into a company, but with a background that included pediatric nursing and being a Mom, I had absolutely no idea how... Enter my local SCORE (Service Corps of Retired Executives) office. There, I was incredibly lucky to be connected with two wonderful gentlemen who had had extensive experience in the food industry. With their expertise and guidance, No Pudge! Foods was begun. FAT FREE Original Fudge Brownie Mix first appeared on the shelves of a few New Hampshire stores in August of 1995.

We believe that some of the best moments in life are spent around the table with the ones you love. In these crazy, dizzy, over-scheduled days, we want to bring people back together.

About the Startup

Describe your product in 3 words.

Delicious. Whimsical. BEST-PANCAKES-EVER

How did you come up with the idea for this product?

I woke up one morning craving pancakes, but was confronted with a rather empty fridge of just eggs, which led me to think: “What if you could crack an egg over the griddle, but instead of getting a fried egg, you’d get a gourmet pancake. What if making pancakes could be that easy?”

What makes your product special?

Before Birch Benders came along, pancakes were stuck in the dark ages. The organic mixes were WAY too expensive and the convenience mixes were filled with junk. We wanted to the perfect pancake with the convenience of just adding water.

What has been the best part of your startup experience?

Lizzi and I started Birch Benders and we have been able to see this company and brand grow together.


Founded in 2011, Matt and his then girlfriend-now-wife, Lizzi set out to build a naturally delicious and cleaned up pancake & waffle mix. The duo experimented with every ingredient they used, and ended up with the fluffiest, tastiest just-add-water pancake & waffle mixes imaginable.
